_comment: Multi-suite monorepo example (P1 area-conditional gates). A web app at the repo root, a Cloud Functions package under functions/, and Firestore security rules. Each tests/lint suite has a `when` git-pathspec and runs ONLY when files in its area change; a suite with no `when` always runs; ANY in-scope suite that fails blocks the push. So none of the three test suites can silently skip while the gate still reports PASS — the blind spot a single root `npx vitest run` leaves. build is on because pushing to main auto-deploys (e.g. Firebase Hosting), so a ~3s local build pre-flight catches a broken build before the deploy. Replace each command and pathspec with your project's. Pathspec note: `*` spans `/` (so `*.rules` matches at any depth, `functions` matches everything under functions/); brace globs like {a,b} are NOT supported — list entries separately. See README -> 'Multi-suite test gates (monorepos)'.
